switch.body: Don't close Realm Portal: it only takes a few seconds.
open.title: Opening the game…
run.title: The game is open
run.closed.title: The game was closed
run.closed.body: You can go back to the list now.

clients.summary: {0} · {1} in use. We only read the paths.
clients.later: You can change them later in Settings.

add.name: Name
add.name.help: How you'll see it in the list.

add.account.help: Only the name. Never the password.

add.error.address: Enter a valid address, for example logon.example.com:3724.
error.gamerunning.title: The game is open
error.gamerunning.body: Close it and try again. Nothing was changed.
error.processcheckfailed.title: We could not check whether the game is open
error.processcheckfailed.body: The process list could not be read, so nothing was changed.
error.permissiondenied.title: No permission to write
error.permissiondenied.body: The system does not let us write to {0}. Nothing was changed.
error.readonlyfs.title: Read-only folder
error.readonlyfs.body: {0} is on a read-only file system. Nothing was changed.
error.pathnotfound.title: Folder not found
error.pathnotfound.body: {0} no longer exists or is not valid. Check the client in Clients.
error.hashmismatch.title: The files changed
error.hashmismatch.body: The client files changed while we were preparing the change. Try again.
error.verifyfailed.title: We could not verify the change
error.verifyfailed.body: What was written does not match what was expected. The files were put back as they were.
error.unsupportedclient.title: Unsupported client
error.unsupportedclient.body: This version of Realm Portal supports clients 1.12.1, 2.4.3, 3.3.5a, 4.3.4 and 5.4.8.
error.invalidrealmlist.title: Invalid realmlist
error.invalidrealmlist.body: The server address has characters or lines that a realmlist does not allow. Check the server.
error.nothingtoundo.title: Nothing to undo
error.nothingtoundo.body: There is no pending change in this client.
error.unknown.title: Something went wrong
conflict.title: Files were modified
conflict.body: Some client files changed after our change, so we left them alone.
discard.title: Discard this backup?
discard.body: Current client files will be kept. Nothing will be restored and you will no longer be able to undo this change from Realm Portal.
menu.play.hint: Switches server and opens the game.
menu.switchonly.hint: Changes the realmlist without opening the game.
menu.switchonly.active: This is already the active server.
settings.error.backup: That backup folder cannot be used.
